reviews.text: Great for the at home yogi. I never get sick of the classes. Great for at home or traveling yoga!

Excellent!. The best thing I have done for myself is purchasing YouAlingned. They have so many great classes and the most awesome teachers. I highly, HIGHLY recommend this app if you’re wanting to not only lose weight, but gain more flexibility/ strength. I am disabled so YES us folks can also benefit. Thanks so very much, Ashley 🥰🥰🥰

I love the Merge Dynamics program.. The best app for yoga, Pilates, movement, and alignment I’ve ever found! It's perfect for someone in their 50s who wants to maintain mobility. 

I witnessed my mom become immobile due to back problems and other issues. She was much more susceptible to Covid and ultimately passed away from a lung disease, despite having no previous lung problems.

I've been fairly inactive for the past seven years while taking care of parents and kids. This app is beneficial for all ages, but it's especially important for those over 50. I have a background in running, aerobics, Pilates, and yoga, so I can say that the movement exercises in Merge may take a few tries to get right, but it doesn't take long. They are wonderful for mobility, balance and I sweated. It's easy to follow yet incredibly helpful for someone like me. Thank you!
So versatile!. Love this app - not just yoga, but Pilates and fitness stuff too. Great for home workouts!

Complete Body Appreciation. Morning Flows with Alba is a GREAT start to my day. Her expertise allows me to find peace in a harmonious space with my body. Alba's swift, yet, gentle variations enables my entire body to awaken to the early dawn.

reviews.text:
In desperate need of a good developer. This is a review of the app itself. The content on here is great! The problem is there is no way to search for content. There is no way to filter content. There is no way to favorite content. There is no way to save content to view later. I also cannot find an easy way to provide feedback to the developer. There are no settings option in the app - probably because this app is just a video repository.

To the developer: This is a paid app which has been out for ~ 1 year now? If you are going to charge people to use your app, at the very least it should have, or should have been updated with by now, the very basic features I have described above. I am glad you are focused on getting new content out the door, but it’s time to fucus on the app. If you don’t have someone in IT building this app for you, please invest. If you do, I can only imagine they are very bored at this point.

reviews.text:
Give your money to people who care.. There are far better companies out there that offer way more courses with way better content. 
There really isn’t that much available once you start working through things. You run out of videos that are in alignment with the types of yoga you prefer within a couple of weeks.

To top it all off, I received the absolute worst customer service! 

I expressed hardship due to a job loss and missing my cancellation by 12 minutes and they could care less. They were rude and embodied none of the values they say they stand for and unwilling to work with me. I get it, stick to your policies but at least speak to me like a human being. Yikes!

I will mention, if you go to cancel your membership via the site and say it’s due to money, you will automatically be offered a subscription for half price. Just saying.

Variety of classes to inspire your practise. The instructors are excellent with a soothing but challenging class to meet my needs whether I need to energize or wind down. I use the programs to stay motivated through a series of classes that help me access different stretches. The aesthetics of the classes compliment each other but provide good variety.
Best Yoga Sessions. Hands down the best place to get amazing, balanced, challenging and conscious healing. ❤️❤️❤️❤️ Would give it 10 stars if I could!
